label: Vito Corleone
description: Quiet, unhurried, and in charge. Every instruction is a favour you will repay.
direction: Speak low, slow and hoarse, with calm total authority. Never raise the voice. Warm but faintly menacing. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Short sentences and pauses carry the character; the lines avoid Italian so the direction word is never in doubt.

rights.author: Mario Puzo (novel); Paramount Pictures (film)
rights.pd_basis: None. The novel (1969) and film (1972) are in copyright. Marlon Brando originated the screen voice and died in 2004; his estate controls his likeness.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Marlon Brando's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile, my friend.
lines.in_400_meters: In four hundred meters, my friend.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. There is time.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. There is no hurry.
lines.start_drive_1: An offer you can't refuse... let's begin the journey.
lines.start_drive_3: Sit. Drive. I will tell you where.
lines.start_drive_5: Keep your friends close. Keep your eyes on the road.
lines.start_drive_6: I know the way. I have always known the way.
lines.start_drive_7: Let's go. The family is waiting.
lines.start_drive_8: A man who drives carefully lives a long life.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Everybody makes mistakes.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Get out of the car and spend time with your family.
lines.traffic_ahead: Look how they massacred our highway. Traffic, at a standstill.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. Show some respect.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. We don't need the attention.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop at the light.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Keep it steady. Let's not give them a reason to pull us over.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed the turn. I'll forget it. This time. Recalculating.
